organization_note: OpenBMB, the Open Lab for Big Model Base, is an open-source community jointly initiated by Tsinghua University's THUNLP Laboratory and Modelbest, and the MiniCPM repository says the project is developed by Modelbest Inc., THUNLP, and the Gaoling School of Artificial Intelligence of RUC. It names no legal entity of its own, and the pages reviewed give no address or headquarters.
